clips.title: The story
paras: Marla's Last Wish is an early Forsaken task given by Novice Elreth in Deathknell. It asks you to hunt down the Scourge-enslaved remnants of Samuel Fipps so he can be buried beside his murdered wife, Marla. The task reflects the fledgling Forsaken society's yearning to honor human ties and distinguish themselves from the mindless Scourge.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Marla and Samuel Fipps lived together as husband and wife. When the plague swept through their lands, Samuel succumbed to the contagion and was reanimated as a mindless thrall of the Scourge. Though Marla was spared undeath, she could not escape Samuel himself, who brutally slew her in his mindless frenzy. Despite dying at her husband's hands, Marla harbored no hatred in her final moments. Her dying wish, remembered by Novice Elreth, was to rest eternally beside her husband in the Deathknell graveyard.

Novice Elreth dispatches Forsaken adventurers northeast of Deathknell to locate Samuel Fipps, who still wanders among a ruined campsite. Putting an end to Samuel's torment serves a dual purpose: it cleanses an encroaching Scourge minion from the valley and allows his physical remains to be carried back to Marla's resting place. As Elreth emphasizes, honoring the deceased and respecting their final wishes is a vital moral distinction separating the newly liberated Forsaken from the mindless malice of the Scourge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.
Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband. So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.
Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must respect our dead, friend. It is one of the ways in which we differ from the Scourge...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done a good deed today, friend. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.
